concerns.text: Constitution VII requires that any claim of ≥10 % lower MAPE for stress‑mediated models be explicitly verified across the held‑out test set and via paired t‑tests. The current task list includes T006 (full training) and T007 (paired t‑tests) but lacks a dedicated verification task that checks the ≥10 % improvement condition and fails the pipeline if the threshold is not met.
